item.title: Using Labour Market Information to Make Career Decisions — Thu Jul 23, 1:00 PM
item.description: Finding the right labour market information (LMI) for your job search can be complex, especially when you’re trying to figure out which jobs are growing, what skills employers are asking for, or where to start your search. Join one of TPL's Career Coaches in Residence, Shenelle Payne Cuffy and an expert from the Labour Market Information Council will introduce two free tools from the LMIC, the Canadian Job Trends Dashboard and the Youth Employment Dashboard. About the Labour Market Information Council (LMIC) LMIC was created to address long-standing challenges in Canada’s labour market information (LMI) ecosystem. LMIC works to improve the timeliness, reliability, and accessibility of labour market information across jurisdictions. This program is part of TPL's Career Coaches in Residence and is generously supported by our lead donor Azrieli Foundation along with supporting donors Fidelity Canada, Friends of Toronto Public Library, South Chapter and William and Nona Heaslip Foundation.

item.description:

We’ll then take a deeper look at Foundry IQ (Azure AI Search), exploring how it helps agents and applications work with curated knowledge and organizational context.
We'll build a knowledge base and connect it to multiple knowledge sources, including the new IQs, MCP servers, and search indexes built from ingested data.

Finally, we will build an agent in Python using Microsoft Agent Framework and ground the agent's responses in results from the Foundry IQ knowledge base.

item.title: Step In, Stand Out: Navigating Your First 90 Days at Work — Wed Aug 5, 12:00 PM
item.description:
The first 90 days in a new job set the tone for your long-term success and this workshop will equip you to step in with clarity and stand out with confidence. Together, we will walk through a structured roadmap built around five key phases: learning and observation, relationship-building, performance and communication excellence, personal brand and visibility, and finally, a powerful bonus 10-day introspection period to help you evaluate alignment and ensure the role truly fits you. You will learn how to adapt to workplace culture, build authentic relationships, ask smart questions, and demonstrate value early. By the end, you will leave with a practical 100-day success plan designed to help you build the next steps of your career with intention.
Source: Toronto Public Library — Young Adults

item.title: Ambunu Plant-based Hair Care — Wed Aug 5, 1:00 PM — Malvern
item.description: In celebration of Emancipation Month, join us to explore Ambunu, a traditional African botanical used for gentle hair cleansing and conditioning. This interactive workshop highlights the rich history of herbal hair care practices and the benefits of plant-based ingredients for scalp and hair wellness. Participants will learn about the science of natural hair care, including how different oils support scalp health and hydration. The session features a guided, hands-on activity where you’ll personalize a prepared Ambunu treatment using essential oils, while also learning about the full herbal preparation and formulation process.
